title: GDscript debug_get_stack_member_state: FOR loop losing members data when pausing on the for loop line
body: ### Tested versions 4.8.dev (c24b8680f5ef80f19bd6e21e47074985f1d52d1b) ### System information Godot v4.8.dev (d0af9e856) - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (nvidia; 550.144.03) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13600KF (20 threads) - 31.17 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description While fixing #92681 it became clear that the stack members of the for-loop block are not visible when pausing on the line of the for-loop. This has gone unnoticed because iterations are skipping that line after the initial definition. With implementation of #120821 , the debugger will correctly pass through the for-loop definition on every iteration. Pausing on that line should show the members related to the iteration. Copying screenshots from the other PR: 4.6.stable: 4.8.dev: Desired output (subject to a new PR): This and #92681 are connected, but are separate issues. That is why I opted to have separate PRs for them. It is better to fix this one before merging the fix in #120821 , as the opposite might cause confusion for developers. ### Steps to reproduce Run the attached project in different versions of Godot ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [example-4.8.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29685108/example-4.8.zip) The control.gd is a copy of the unit test for_loop_iterator_array_size.gd with added _ready() to run the tests.
